Keeping IoT information fresh through LEO satellites means fighting propagation delay, satellite handovers, and inter-satellite links — under a power budget. This work proposes uplink and downlink AoI models that capture those delays, and EA-AoI, a deep-reinforcement-learning scheduler paired with a low-complexity power allocation scheme. It achieves lower AoI than SIC-based, AoI-greedy, and random scheduling on both simulated and real-world satellite trajectories, while keeping the long-term average allocated power within a predefined threshold.
